slides.texte_overlay:
Things a man's home
should have by 30
A proper bed frame. No more mattress on the floor. A real bed makes your room feel adult and makes guests take you more seriously.
Enough chairs for friends. Four people should be able to sit and eat together. A home that can host people is a home that stays full of life.
Real plates and glasses that match. Not a mix of mugs from different flats. Small details make dinners feel special. Guests notice.
A first-aid kit. Plasters, painkillers, bandages, a thermometer. You'll be glad you have it the moment someone gets hurt.
Before: my shelves were empty and so was my mind. After: five minutes a day of history, art or science, and both are filling up.
slides.texte_sophia: Before: my shelves were empty and so was my mind. After: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. Both are filling up.

slides.texte_overlay: A few good books on display. Not for show, for reading. Books make a room feel warm and say something about who you are.
A plant you keep alive. It sounds small, but taking care of something living makes a home feel calmer and more cared for.
